reviewer: Independent AI visual reviewer. Publisher-blurred original images were inspected and annotated before any model predictions. No human performance or driving-safety claim is measured.
population: Fourteen UAE driver-view images on fourteen distinct previously unevaluated recording sequences. The primary eight were used to improve the revised method after the baseline. Only the untouched six evaluate transfer of that revision. These are purposively balanced small samples.

measurement.direct: A native destination pin strictly inside any separately frozen polygon, with a visible Save control and the same two-dimensional point after explicit browser confirmation. A wrong-location pin on a positive is measured separately. A lack of an offer on a negative is appropriate only when completed without operational failure.
measurement.alternatives: Separately selectable alternate areas would be distinguished from an automatic destination. No first turn rendered an alternative list in these five arms.
measurement.vehicle: Diagnostic body matching uses native box intersection-over-union >= 0.50. A unique correct outline, the intended body among extra outlines, a wrong-only outline, and no outline are separate. This diagnostic threshold was set for scoring; polygon-inclusion was preregistered before model outputs.
measurement.road: The browser submitted one preregistered through-road point from a clean session, using the visible real-image marking controls. Each actual source point was checked within 0.4% of the native image diagonal of its intended tap. A withheld road test supplies zero automatic parking positives.
measurement.time: Wall-clock milliseconds from submit to visible terminal response; timing excludes loading the photo, preparing sources, and the human action to save. Median and range are supplied because cohorts are small.
measurement.short: The same eight photos and physical references were tested with shorter questions fixed before the original runs. Two questions lose a positional disambiguator; offering their intended location by coincidence does not prove resolution of the shorter ambiguous language.
